messages.text:
The prompt is exceptionally detailed — CSL format spec, output schema, glyph dictionary, anti-patterns, and even the agent-timeframe philosophy are all already nailed down. No ambiguity worth burning a turn on. Launching the research now.

Your full-stack engineer agent persona spec is ready. It synthesizes 17 sourced claims from Ousterhout, Agans, Charity Majors, DORA/Accelerate, OWASP Top 10:2025, Google SRE, and Anthropic/Simon Willison into a loadable agent context. The artifact contains two parts: a research brief with cited claims and synthesis, followed by a drop-in persona spec covering principles, workflow loops, decision logic, the Agans debugging pipeline, full-stack coverage, security invariants, memory module, test cases, and anti-patterns. The load-bearing piece is the agent-timeframe module, which replaces human-calendar pessimism with a feasibility test of decomposability + verifiability + rollback — designed to be pasted verbatim into a coding agent's system prompt or CLAUDE.md.
